title: TSB Resource
description: Base schema for Tetrate Service Bridge managed resources including organizations, tenants, workspaces, clusters, applications, and APIs.

name.description: Resource name. Must be 1-63 characters, lowercase alphanumeric with hyphens.

fqn.description: Fully-qualified name of the resource in the TSB resource hierarchy. e.g. organizations/myorg/tenants/myteam

displayName.description: Human-readable display name for the resource.

etag.description: Version tag for optimistic concurrency. Must be included in PUT requests.

Organization.title: Organization
Organization.description: A TSB organization representing a corporation or enterprise entity.

deletionProtectionEnabled.description: Prevents accidental deletion of the organization.

Tenant.title: Tenant
Tenant.description: A TSB tenant representing a team or department within an organization.

deletionProtectionEnabled.description: Prevents accidental deletion of the tenant.

Workspace.title: Workspace
Workspace.description: A TSB workspace providing namespace isolation for microservice teams.

namespaceSelector.description: Selects Kubernetes namespaces assigned to this workspace.

names.description: List of namespace selectors in cluster/namespace format.

Cluster.title: Cluster
Cluster.description: A Kubernetes cluster onboarded to TSB management.

network.description: Network identifier for multi-network mesh deployments.

tier1Cluster.description: If true, this cluster acts as a Tier-1 gateway cluster.

tokenTtl.description: TTL for cluster service account tokens.

Application.title: Application
Application.description: A TSB application grouping related APIs and gateway configuration.

workspace.description: FQN of the workspace hosting this application.

API.title: API
API.description: A TSB API definition attaching an OpenAPI v3 spec to an application.

openapi.description: Raw OpenAPI v3 spec in YAML or JSON format.

workloadSelector.description: Selects the gateway workload to route traffic to.
